description: A WPF app with a custom maximize button does not show Windows 11 Snap Layouts on hover, from https://stackoverflow.com/questions/69097246/how-to-support-for-windows-11-snap-layout-to-the-custom-maximize-restore-butto.
prompt: My WPF window has a custom title bar, and my maximize/restore button works, but Windows 11 Snap Layouts never appear when I hover that button. How can I keep the custom look without losing the OS snap menu?
